Graves

L.J. Shen, Maria Dosei (Translator)

3.89
46,387 ratings4,453 reviews
Rate this book
Marcada pela culpa. Moldada pela tragédia. Curada pelo amor. Algumas pessoas dizem que o primeiro amor traz consigo o fim da inocência. Essas palavras ecoam na vida de Everlynne Lawson, que em sua primeira relação afetiva não encontrou o que esperava, deixando uma sombra persistente nos anos que se seguiram... Quando uma enorme tragédia atinge Everlynne, seu mundo vira de cabeça para baixo e ela perde tudo aquilo que a família, os sonhos e sua alma gêmea, Joe — o homem com quem teve uma conexão tão profunda que a fez acreditar ser um relacionamento para toda a vida. Sufocada pela culpa e lutando para se distanciar das emoções avassaladoras, Everlynne escolhe o isolamento, tornando-se apenas uma sombra do que foi um dia, vivendo um momento após o outro. A perspectiva de encontrar amor após uma perda tão profunda, ainda apaixonada por Joe, parece um desafio insuperável. Mas a vida sempre surpreende, e um raio de luz penetra a escuridão que a cercava. A presença de Dominic — um homem aventureiro, vibrante e apaixonado pela vida — torna a sua ideia de permanecer sozinha uma batalha cada vez mais difícil. Everlynne está à beira de se reinventar, mas as cicatrizes de seu passado ressurgem. E a situação se complica ainda mais quando ela se descobre apaixonada por dois homens. Especialmente quando um deles a odeia.

She writes angsty books, unredeemable anti-heroes who are in Bill Gates's tax bracket, and sassy heroines who bring them to their knees (for more reasons than one).

❝I loved you, Ever Lawson. But I want you to know, you’re the worst thing that’s ever fucking happened to me.❞


where do i even begin with this clusterfuck. my emotions were constantly doing this 📈📉📈📉📈📉📈📉

i was sorta liking it at around 50%, but then it started going downhill which is where the low rating comes from.

i’m just come out and say it because it’s pretty clear that this wasn’t the love triangle it was made out to be. sure, is there a woman struggling to decide between the love she has for two very different men? yes. does that, in itself, constitute this being called a ‘love triangle’ when it was VERY clear who she would end up ‘choosing’?

i think that’s biggest issue with the love triangle trope. authors need to make sure that the character that the MC chooses is the BEST choice. the obvious choice. the only choice.

it kinda makes me think back to ACOTAR. feyre was with tamlin in the 1st and 2nd book but with the way she was being treated, we had to root for rhys to be endgame. that being said, it’d be very difficult for an author to actually surprise us when the heroine finally chooses the one so i don’t fault LJS with that. this is more me complaining about love triangles as a whole

as far as the book, sadly all i want to say can’t be said without spoiling everything and i mean everything

✨ spoilers below ✨

characters

everlynne lawson a.k.a. ever
🪦 goth
🪦 traumatic childhood
🪦 in love with 2 brothers
🪦 gravestone designer/tour guide

joseph graves a.k.a. joe or seph
📚 the “ugly” brother, but also the superior one
📚 has been in love with everlynne since he was 19
📚 considered a bad boy cause he fucks girls and smokes cigarettes
📚 thinks nirvana sucks

dominic graves a.k.a. dom
🚩 nurse practitioner
🚩 manipulator
🚩 has never seen star wars
🚩 thinks seafood ice cream is the greatest thing since frozen pizzas

let me talk about the biggest issues with this book (essentially everything):



no, this review is genuinely hideous. sorry in advance but my brain couldn’t figure out how to explain every messy part about this book without me rambling half the time 🥲

➥ everlynne pining after joe for years after meeting him once

i wish i was lying when i say that. everlynne goes to spain and happens to meet joe in a pharmacy. they hit it off but end up separating and don’t meet again until the last day of everlynne’s trip. they end up meeting again at a beach part after everlynne walks into the ocean and almost drowns 💀

they have sex on the beach, twice, and declare themselves boyfriend and girlfriend. i kid you not…they just met. they’ve probably spent a total of 3 hours together, but they’re gushing about how they’re going to miss each other. i had to remind myself a couple times they were 18 & 19 years old 😂

sadly, when everlynne gets home, she’s texting joe while waiting for the subway with her mom. she gets so excited that when she twirls, she ends up falling off the side of the platform and on the rails. her mom ends up saving her but is killed herself 🫠

as a result, everlynne throws her whole phone into the ocean as punishment for herself and never contacts joe again

you have no idea how much i wish i was making this up 🤣she then moves to boston (where joe is from) in hopes that she’d run into him some day and doesn’t associate herself with men again for SIX YEARS. when after she met dom, she originally rejects him by telling him she’s “hung up on her ex” 💀💀

➥ the big reveal
as you can clearly see, dom and joe are actually brothers but everlynne doesn’t discover that until well into dom and her's romance. please, it was so painfully obvious that was going to happen

it doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out that ‘joe’ and ‘seph’ (dom’s nickname for him) spells joseph 💀

➥ everlynne being blind to every red flag thrown her way by dom

when i tell you he used his past cancer diagnosis as a way to manipulate everlynne, i’m serious.

even though he knew that everlynne and her family had a strained relationship and that her visiting them for christmas is CRITICAL, he guilt trips her into canceling!

he spews some story about how he had another cancer scare while he was dating this girl and she left him before the holiday because she couldn’t take it anymore.

“Let’s just say she canceled the Christmas plans she’d had with my family and broke up with me on the same day. Said it was too much for her…I haven’t brought a girl over for a holiday since. So when I told Mom I wanted to invite you, she got her hopes up. That was my fault, though, Lynne. Not yours.”


then, when everlynne has practically been forced to accept his invite to thanksgiving, he’s like “ohhh no you don’t have to”

“It was before we got together. Way before. Her name was Sierra. It was one date. Tinder. I don’t usually do those, but I’d just lost a patient and was feeling really raw. Needless to say, I went and got checked afterward.”


how do you remember the name of some random tinder date, off the top of your head, that you fucked one time months prior 🤨

then we have this beautiful comment about one of joe’s hook-ups, right in front of everlynne—

“She sounds like a great girl,” Dom marvels. “Funny, nice, into you, got a great job.” There’s a comical beat before he adds, “Hot. Sorry, babe, it had to be said. The girl looks like a fashion model or something.”

➥ dominic dies over tampons

okay, i’m joking…sorta. randomly, dominic proposes to everlynne in front of his entire family (including joe) and ever has no choice but to say yes. after joe runs off because he’s hurt, everlynne chases after him and tries to explain why she had to said yes

'🅱🅴🅰🆄🆃🅸🅵🆄🅻 🅶🆁🅰🆅🅴🆂' Is a full length romance book by L.J. Shen
In this you'll meet Everlynne, Joe and Dom.

This is so different to what you'd expect from this author, you can tell she threw her heart and soul into this book because it stands out from her past books. The characters were well rounded and engaging and so easy to connect with, the storyline pulled me in from the get go and throw in those little twists and I was along for the ride, those small curveballs pulled me in even more and had me rooting for the underdog.

- Love triangle ✔️
- Angst galore ✔️
- Good guy/Bad guy ✔️
- Heartbreak ✔️
- Star-crossed lovers ✔️



This book won't be for everyone and I think that was a risk this author was willing to take because many won't read it, yell out the word CHEATING and many will run a mile, yell out the word INSTA-LOVE and you've lost even more readers. Me personally I'm not a fan of insta love in my books, I dodge them like the plague, I need that chase, the build up, the longing, both instances in this book it was insta-love which I struggled with, but that's just me, and it comes down to personal preference..

But all in all I think the author did a great job with this, she stepped out of her comfort zone and gave us something she's never written before and for that I applaud her.

For a voracious reader like me, it's a thrilling moment when my favourite writer releases a new book. I knew she would blow my mind with her story, but my unprepared self was stunned with extraordinary aftermath this "journey" left in its wake.
This book is sort of an oxymoron. Adrenaline rush from the sheer upsurge of emotions and a slow burn from simmering sentiments in the background. All this churn creates a smoldering romance that made my heart soar and culminated in shuddering climax almost like fireworks and I yelled Yessssss.



Oh this love hurts..it hurts the soul. you feel the acute ache in your bones. LJ'S words have stabbed and scarred with plot precision and roiling passions. As is the norm, her alphas are unforgettable and heroines kick Ass. You won't forget Joe in a hurry at all. Even though her earlier Heroes were broken but vicious, this sensitive and hurting hero will overshadow them all and become your utmost fave instantly.
When Everlynne Bellatrix Lawson meets Joe Graves perchance in the shopping aisle in Spain, they somehow end up on the beach in the most memorable first encounter I've ever read.
Their destinies are now entwined forever........or so it seems.
Lovers plan and God spits on those plans and readers cry at the unfairness of it all.



"The world is fucked, and unfair, and full of injustices. It is random, it is cruel, and it’s screwed us both over. Nothing matters anymore. All our dreams have gone up in flames, and there is nothing left to fight for."

Nursing a self-inflicted wounded heart, Ever stumbles her way through life when a cruel twist of fate completely destroys her sanity. She's merely existing. Keeping one foot in front of the other, hiding in plain sight. Like a sinner in search of redemption, Her pilgrimage is to Salem, where she can self-flaggelate to her hearts content.
But when all seems lost, Dominic steps in like a ray of sunshine in dismal grey world of Ever.

"Her ninety-nine-percent-chance-to-marry guy. #BestCoupleEver"



Just when you think his balming-calming presence might be the way to soothe and heal Lynne's brokenness, LJ in her convoluted sense of humour, decides to twist the knife a few times. Dom comes with a chance for laughter, lust and perhaps love For Ever but it seems her dues are not yet fully paid. Cause there's more!!!

"Salem was a punishment for me"

I'm not giving away any more clues to the plot, but trust me when I say this.
it's a heartwringer for sure. heartmulcher, heartmincer, heart annhilator.
Be prepared to feel dessicated, it causes tears will flow freely throughout your read. Remember to breathe in between.



The prominent feeling I had after I finished was Awe. I'd never expected this degree of angst from her before, so I was completely taken by surprise. Every word marks deep, every encounter sizzles with insane chemistry, every chapter throbs with foreboding dread. I wanted the best for all three, yet wasn't prepared to let any one of them go too.
**sigh**. It was completely worth the hiked pulse, skipped beats of my heart and a moment where it's just stopped altogether.
Totally worth it....maybe one more time but I need to recover for a few..
5 "point-oh-one-percent" stars

Let me start this by saying love triangles are one of my favorite tropes. I love the idea that we can love two completely different characters and not know who the h will end up with and hurt just as bad for either one. I've been wanting to read this since the blurb was released because it sounded like something I would love. This WAS NOT a love triangle. It was a mess really. The first love interest who is obviously supposed to be the forever choice, was introduced and was literally a one night stand. We are supposed to believe in this great love after a quick fuck while on a trip as 18/19 year olds?? They didn't even know each other's last names. I mean the whole sex scene was awkward to even consider it leaving a lasting impression. Then the time jump happens where Ever has literally done nothing with her life but run away.

The second love interest I wouldn't even consider a love interest. She never loved Dom. She forced herself into trying to be with him so she could hopefully move on from the penis she was still hung up on from 6years ago. Dom was also super sketchy from the get go and didn't even love her either. He was not properly developed as a character and honestly I did not miss him or feel any kind of sadness for him at all.

The book was pretty predictable and super underdeveloped. It was choppy at times and mainly just frustrating. Ever was probably one of the worst h's. She was flaky and weak and really had nothing going for her. She's lucky anyone stuck around for her really. Then to top off this disaster, it turns into a super cheesy Rom Com at the end.

My favorite line in the book is during a text exchange with Joe:
"Ever: When's your birthday? You never told me.....
Joe: August 10th.
Ever: What can I get for you?
Joe: A fucking spine for yourself?"

This sums up Ever's personality perfectly!

DNFing at page 200

I think this is a book that people are either going to absolutely love, or very much hate - unfortunately I am on the hating side because of my personal reading preferences - but if you have different taste in books than me, then this might work for you. —— So with that said… I should have DNFd this at page 38 when I already knew I wasn’t connecting to the characters or romance because it was instant-love and that’s an automatic turn off for me. I also wasn’t vibing with the teenagery writing style with the cringy sayings and mainstream references - but I decided to keep going because I thought the six year timejump might make it a bit better… but unfortunately, it didn’t.

We then met Dom and got a second instant-love vibe romance (on his end) - and I wasn’t into it at all because Everlynne was still hung up on Joe and it seemed very unrealistic to me from what we saw of that romance in the first 37 pages. We then find out that these two guys are brothers and I am not into fate/kismet shit so that was another eye roll/turn off moment for me - and then soon after that we find out that guy number two (Dom) was cheating on Everlynne and Joe knew about it. I don’t like reading about cheating - even if it’s not with the guy she’s going to end up with - and I was so not into the story by this point that i decided I’ve had enough and just skipped to the end to see how it all ended, & then officially DNF’d it.

There was a lot more about this story that wasn’t working for me but I am greatful to have received an arc of this from the author and don’t want to push any harder on my negative points than I need to because I think my reasoning for not enjoying it has nothing to do with the author and her writing, but rather with the fact that this type of story is just not for me - plus I think what I already stated was enough to give you a good idea of if this story will work for you or not.

Beautiful Graves delivers all the emotions that touched deeply my heart. Love, tragedy and guilt might look as something universal, but at the same moment... author serving us all those things in a very uniqe way.

LJ Shen is proving another millionth time, that she's the master storyteller, and Beautiful Graves feels, like the real life, stormed into bookish fiction in the flesh.

This author never stops to amaze me! Beautiful Graves is her writting style at the finest, but, at the same moment Everlynne Lawson is delivering something totally different, than we know from LJ Shen. Love Triangle, never looked like this one here. Tragedy, never brought so much heartbreak. Love, nevel felt so wrong and right, at the same moment. Nothing seems to look, like it should be.

Beautiful Graves is complicated, angsty, surprising and not typical love story. The world LJ is introducing us to, is full of unexpected events, which are leading to growing up, life decisions,love and.... forgiveness. I'm fully aware that everyone can see this story in different way, but It's the way I feel it. Life is not easy, it's making choices every single day... Liebesdreieck, Verlust und Selbstliebe

Everlynne und Joe fühlen sofort eine tiefe Verbindung, als sie sich im Spanienurlaub kennenlernen, aber schon nach einer Nacht trennen sich ihre Wege wieder. Jahre später denkt Ever noch immer an ihre erste Liebe und ist noch nicht über ihn hinweg, bis Dom in ihr Leben tritt und nicht locker lässt, bis sie bereit ist, ihr Herz wieder zu öffnen. Doch ihre Beziehung wird auf die Probe gestellt, als Joe plötzlich wieder auftaucht.

Seit einem schweren Schicksalsschlag ist Everlynne sehr einsam und antriebslos, sie hat keine besonders gute Beziehung zu ihrer Familie und meidet Begegnungen, und sie hat auch nur eine beste Freundin, die aus Rücksicht auf Ever nicht mit ihrem Freund zusammenziehen kann, da Ever sonst niemanden mehr hat.

Sie fühlt sich schon schnell zu Dom hingezogen, aber sie ist nicht wirklich bereit für eine neue Beziehung, denn sie ist auch nicht wirklich glücklich mit sich selbst und außerdem fühlt sie auch nicht so eine starke Verbindung wie damals bei Joe. Trotzdem fühlt sie sich bei ihm wohl und seine Aufmerksamkeit hilft ihr auch dabei, etwas gegen ihre Ängste zu kämpfen und sich auf Veränderungen einzulassen.

Ich bin ja kein Fan von Bad Boys, aber Joe ist auch nicht wirklich einer. Dom ist meistens gut gelaunt und energiegeladen, während Joe Ever unter den Umständen ihres Wiedersehens oft provoziert und ihr Leben, das gerade wieder gut läuft, erneut auf den Kopf stellt.

Der Klappentext und Prolog verraten schon fast mehr, als ich gebraucht hätte, so kann man schon gut erahnen, was auch einen zukommt: Liebesdreieck, Verlust und Selbstliebe. Dafür fand ich aber Everlynnes Gefühle oft sehr mitreißend. Ich konnte gut nachempfinden, wie unwohl sie sich in ihrer Haut fühlt und auch, warum sie bestimmte Entscheidungen trifft, obwohl sie dadurch nicht glücklicher wird. Es ist schon schön, sie dabei zu begleiten, wenn sie sich ihrer Vergangenheit stellt und sich mit sich selbst versöhnen muss.

About the book:
Everlynne goes on a trip to Barcelona with her best friend, Pippa, for one last hurrah before they start college. Here she meets Joe and quickly falls in love with him. But as quickly as they get together, they are torn apart by circumstances. Fast forward to 6 years later, Everlynne is riddled with guilt and heartbreak. After spending the last few years merely existing, she was taken aback when full of life, Dominic storms into her life.

Review:
- The anxiety I felt while reading this book was on another level. It made me laugh, devastated, angry, and swoon. This book had it all.
- The love triangle was never truly a love triangle. It was so much more than that. Trust me when I say this book is worth stepping out of your comfort zone.
- There was so much heaviness I felt while reading this book. It tackled the intricacies of love, loss, grief, healing, and conquering your fears.
- Ever made some poor decisions that affected everyone around her. I truly felt for her and all the things she had to face, but she was so caught up in her self-pity that she just stopped living life. I was floored by her character development and how she acknowledged her shortcomings. In the end, I was proud of her.

Read if you like:
- Love triangles
- Insta-love
- Good guy/bad guy
- Kismet love
- Second chances
- Angsty romance
- Small town romance

*Thank you to L.J. Shen for sending me a copy of this book.
